name: Nenad Bijedic
summary: Nenad Bijedic has 2 coaching stints at 2 clubs (30 league games) in the dataset, from 2005/06 to 2006/07. Too few games for a grade (the ranking requires at least 3 stints and 10 games). The best stint above squad-value expectation was Sakaryaspor 2006/07 (-0.35 PPG); the toughest was Diyarbakirspor 2005/06 (-0.39 PPG).
